meta.name: code-hardener
meta.description: Mandatory second-stage logic filter and architectural hardening skill that runs after NEURO for ANY code change, bug fix, new feature, refactor, API change, data contract change, performance optimization, security fix, architectural decision, configuration change, test modification, integration work, debugging, analysis, planning, or implementation. Executes exactly 5 mandatory iterations. Validates NEURO recommendations against repo truth, calls NEURO with filtered critique, then emits the only implementation plan opencode may follow. Use after any neuro skill usage. Use when code is about to be edited. Use for every non-trivial code modification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在改代码前为实施计划做二次校验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望每次代码改动前都有更可靠的方案
copy.tagline_en: Validate your implementation plan before touching code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a second validation before making code changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 NEURO 的修改建议跑 5 轮强制过滤:核实仓库真相,再查范围/契约、安全/性能、测试/回滚,最后输出唯一可执行的实施方案(允许/禁止改的文件、确切改动、命令、回滚风险)。只有该方案存在才允许改代码;缺失或过期则禁止改动。
howto.when: 在 NEURO 完成全部 10 轮分析后自动接管;也适用于你要求代码加固或架构改进,或 opencode 准备按 NEURO 建议改生产代码时。

say.text: 按 NEURO 的分析结果改代码,先做 5 轮加固。
say.note: 它会生成实施方案,清单齐全才允许改动。

say.text: 刚才的改动建议先过一遍 code-hardener。
say.note: 强制跑满 5 轮,再给出可执行清单。

say.text: 把这次的架构改动走一遍加固流程。
say.note: 没有 final review 或实施清单,它不会改代码。

howto.what_en: Claude passes NEURO suggestions through 5 mandatory filter rounds and emits the only implementation plan (allowed/forbidden files, exact changes, commands, rollback risks). Edits only after that plan exists; missing/stale plan blocks edits.
howto.when_en: Automatically after NEURO completes all 10 iterations; also when you ask for code hardening or architecture improvement, or when opencode is about to edit production code after NEURO review.

say_en.text: Apply NEURO's analysis to code changes, with 5 rounds of hardening first.
say_en.note: Generates the manifest; edits only after it's complete.

say_en.text: Run code-hardener on the recent change suggestions.
say_en.note: Forces all 5 iterations, then outputs a manifest.

say_en.text: Run this architecture change through the hardening flow.
say_en.note: Without the final review or manifest, it won't edit code.
